_comment: DNS health alerts for the SOLIDserver DNS servers (hera and lion run named). Same firing + '<name>_cleared' pairing as the DHCP alerts (docs/efficientip-openobserve.md). Firing template: dns-firing.template.json (shared); cleared template: dns-cleared.template.json, one copy per alert with <ALERT_NAME> replaced. Every query returns the columns host, zone, peer, detail that the templates read. Measured against the real stream on 2026-10-11 (24 h).

alerts.sql: SELECT host, regexp_replace(message, '.*transfer of ''([^'']+)''.*', '$1') AS zone, regexp_replace(message, '.* from ([0-9.]+)#.*', '$1') AS peer, message AS detail FROM "network_syslog" WHERE appname='named' AND host IN ('hera.middlebury.edu','lion.middlebury.edu') AND ((message LIKE '%transfer of%' AND (message LIKE '%failed%' OR message LIKE '%REFUSED%' OR message LIKE '%NOTAUTH%' OR message LIKE '%timed out%')) OR (message LIKE '%Transfer status:%' AND message NOT LIKE '%success%')) ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
alerts.measured: 0 matches in 24 h; 60,315 successful 'Transfer status: success' lines on lion in the same period, so any match is real.
alerts.note: The failure wording is BIND's standard text and has not been seen in this stream yet; confirm against the first real failure.

alerts.sql: SELECT host, 'middlebury.edu' AS zone, 'n/a' AS peer, concat('only ', cast(c AS varchar), ' completed transfers in 15 minutes (normal: hundreds)') AS detail FROM (SELECT 'lion.middlebury.edu' AS host, count(*) AS c FROM "network_syslog" WHERE host='lion.middlebury.edu' AND appname='named' AND message LIKE '%Transfer completed%' AND message LIKE '%middlebury.edu/IN%') WHERE c < 20 UNION ALL SELECT host, 'middlebury.edu' AS zone, 'n/a' AS peer, concat('only ', cast(c AS varchar), ' served transfers in 15 minutes (normal: hundreds)') AS detail FROM (SELECT 'hera.middlebury.edu' AS host, count(*) AS c FROM "network_syslog" WHERE host='hera.middlebury.edu' AND appname='named' AND message LIKE '%IXFR ended%' AND message LIKE '%middlebury.edu/IN%') WHERE c < 100
alerts.measured: Per 15 minutes on the middlebury.edu zone over 24 h: lion 'Transfer completed' min 104, median 330; hera 'IXFR ended' min 400, median 1310. Thresholds 20 and 100 are far below normal.
alerts.note: The count is zero-row safe: it is computed first and then filtered, so a host with no lines at all still returns a row.

alerts.sql: SELECT host, regexp_replace(message, '.*zone ([^:]+): notify.*', '$1') AS zone, regexp_replace(message, '.*notify to ([0-9.]+)#.*', '$1') AS peer, message AS detail FROM "network_syslog" WHERE appname='named' AND host IN ('hera.middlebury.edu','lion.middlebury.edu') AND message LIKE '%/IN/Internal:%' AND message LIKE '%notify to%failed%' AND message NOT LIKE '%notify to 140.233.36.197#%' AND message NOT LIKE '%notify to 140.233.36.98#%' AND message NOT LIKE '%notify to 140.233.9.4#%' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
alerts.measured: Internal view only. About 290,000 notify failures a day go to three standing targets (140.233.36.197, 140.233.36.98, 140.233.9.4), excluded here; delete those lines once the stale secondaries are fixed in SOLIDserver. External-view notifies to third-party secondaries (Cloudflare 162.159.x and the new rikert* zones' hosts) time out routinely and are not alerted.

alerts.sql: SELECT host, regexp_replace(message, '.*zone transfer ''([^'']+)''.*', '$1') AS zone, regexp_replace(message, '.*client @0x[0-9a-f]+ ([0-9.]+)#.*', '$1') AS peer, message AS detail FROM "network_syslog" WHERE appname='named' AND host IN ('hera.middlebury.edu','lion.middlebury.edu') AND message LIKE '%zone transfer%' AND message LIKE '%denied%' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
alerts.measured: 0 matches in 24 h. A match means a host that is not an allowed secondary asked for a zone copy.
